name: Select File
purpose: Field Selector: after the user picks a file, sets the scripts-mode or fields-mode flag in the Picker record and loads the script list (220) or table-occurrence list (223); then moves focus to the Script or TableOccurence object.
writes:
Picker::Schema_ScriptsInd#30 (Set Field step 10, current record)
Picker::Schema_FieldsInd#29 (Set Field step 17, current record)
calls:
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/220 ("Set Script Array", step 11)
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/223 ("Set TableOccurence Array", step 19)
open_question: Step 11 passes a commented-out parameter (/*VirtualList_File::FileName*/), so script 220 receives an empty parameter. Step 19 passes the file name from VIRTUALLISTS_Rows::json_SchemaPicker_File instead of the $SelectedFileName read at step 4.

name: Select Table
purpose: Field Selector: after the user picks a table, loads its table occurrences (223) and moves focus to the TableOccurence list.

name: Select TableOccurence
purpose: Field Selector: after the user picks a table occurrence, loads its fields (224) and moves focus to the Field list.

name: Select Field
purpose: Field Selector: toggles a field in the picker's result list (Picker::Schema_Results, a JSON array): removes the field if already selected, otherwise adds the field object. Closes the picker window unless multiple selections are allowed.

name: Select Script
purpose: Field Selector: toggles a script in the picker's result list (Picker::Schema_Results): removes it if already selected, otherwise adds it. Closes the picker window unless multiple selections are allowed.
